Welcome back! Last time, we were discussing robots and their actuator systems. You asked about my robotic arm, didn't you? 🙂
Before we start, would you like me to ask three quick questions to refresh your memory from last time? You can say yes or no. 🙂
Yes

In our previous session, we explored different types of robots and their components, including actuators and robotic arms. We also discussed the importance of understanding how these parts work together to enable a robot's movements. I'm glad you're excited to learn more about robotics! 🙂
What is an actuator in a robot? 🙂
I don't know.
I would judge their answer as "incorrect". Here's a gentle correction: "An actuator in a robot is actually a component that helps move or control the robot's movements, such as motors or pumps." 🙂
Can you name one type of robot we discussed last time? 🙂
Human nature buts.
Incorrect. Here's a gentle correction: We didn't discuss robots with human nature buts. Instead, we explored different types of robots and their components, such as actuators and robotic arms. 🙂
Today I can teach you one beginner topic: machine learning, how robots sense the world, or large language models. I suggest we start with machine learning. Ready? 🙂
Yes

llm_call_samples.reply: Machine learning is a type of AI that enables machines to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. It's like how you learn new things by observing and practicing! 😊
